intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ (Mockito / StepVerifier where reactive) tests for ReorderWindow, asserting only against ast_hints. Unit: Context Telemetry Stream Intake. Aggregate holding reorder window state (source of truth). Constructed with the window Duration (from config). Thread-safe (synchronized). Orders by deviceTimestamp, never ingressTimestamp. offer: a sample whose deviceTimestamp is older than the last released timestamp is late (not buffered; OfferResult.late=true); a sample older than the newest buffered/seen deviceTimestamp but not late is out-of-order (buffered, OfferResult.outOfOrder=true); otherwise buffered normally. drainReleasable(now) removes and returns, sorted by deviceTimestamp ascending, buffered samples with deviceTimestamp <= now - window, and advances the released watermark. Nested record OfferResult(boolean late, boolean outOfOrder).
